🌐 Why Open Source

Transparent by design

AbhiHub was built by a student, for students. Making it open source means anyone can audit the code, suggest improvements, or adapt it for their own college community.

  • No hidden data collection — read the code yourself
  • Community-driven improvements and bug fixes
  • Free to fork and deploy for your own institution

🤝 How to Contribute

Get involved in 4 steps

No contribution is too small — from fixing a typo to building a new feature.

1
Fork & clone
Fork the repo on GitHub, then run git clone locally.
2
Set up your environment
Copy .env.example → .env, fill in your keys, then pip install -r requirements-min.txt.
3
Make your change
Follow the docs in .documentation/. Run pytest before committing.
4
Open a Pull Request
Push your branch and open a PR. Describe what you changed and why.
